chapter: The Legends of Jazz and life on the road
title: Touring Europe with the Legends
summary: He says he has been to Europe about twenty times, five times in 1978, and was known there from old records.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: some of the experiences that you had travelling with this group? You've been to Europe now how many times?
Oh, I don't know, twenty times I guess.
You went to Europe five times in one year? What year was that?
Did you just travel all over the continent?
Oh, yes, every western country--every country in western Europe. We played every country in western Europe.
Oh, Europe is very good with the Legends; very good.
Did you find any of the people knew exactly who you were?
Yes they did. Barry said that one of the reasons that he wanted me was that the people over there know you, they heard your records and know about you.
That was due to the fact that on one of the oldest records, somebody took it off of the radio and sent it to Europe and made an LP out of it.
We still have a lot of that kind of thing unfortunately, with the illegal taping of records. We're glad you had a good reception there.
